svg.text: a run
the canary
three fixed loops - compute, cache, memory -
read within a few percent of their committed baseline,
or the machine is not in its measured state
refused
the datapath probe
how wide is the vector unit really: 256:128 reads
about 2 as a control; 512:256 reads 1.14 on this laptop
and 2.01 on a Zen 5 runner
refused
residency
the whole table stayed in memory. A table that
spills recomputes every iteration and passes
every other rule with a better number
refused
EXPLAIN, and no fallback
every entry expected to fuse plans with a Varka
node, and not one batch of it fell through the
trapdoor - a blend would look like a kernel rate
refused
the fixed-share rule
the job's constant - scheduling, collecting - is under
5% of a Varka row's wall time, or the row is
measuring the harness
fails
the band
twelve repeated runs give each case a tier;
a move inside its tier is noise, and no
row is quoted without one
unquoted
the committed results file
cpu, jdk, kernel, rows, cache, MaxVectorSize,
the probe's reading and the canary's, then the numbers
and the quote check: every decimal in the docs traces to one of these files, or the build fails
